title: Little dragon with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8dffb0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2fbf6e'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='wingGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe27a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f2a93b'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- wings behind body -->
  <path d='M38 46 Q20 26 14 38 Q10 48 26 52 Q18 56 26 62 Q34 64 40 54 Z' fill='url(#wingGrad)' stroke='#d9852a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M62 46 Q80 26 86 38 Q90 48 74 52 Q82 56 74 62 Q66 64 60 54 Z' fill='url(#wingGrad)' stroke='#d9852a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M50 78 Q40 88 28 86 Q18 84 22 76 Q26 70 32 74 Q30 80 36 79 Q44 80 50 74 Z' fill='url(#bodyGrad)' stroke='#1f8f52' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- tail spike -->
  <path d='M22 76 L14 68 L20 82 Z' fill='#ffe27a' stroke='#d9852a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='20' ry='18' fill='url(#bodyGrad)' stroke='#1f8f52' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#d9ffe6'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='80' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#2fbf6e' stroke='#1f8f52' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='80' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#2fbf6e' stroke='#1f8f52' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='17' fill='url(#bodyGrad)' stroke='#1f8f52' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#7dffab'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#1f8f52'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#1f8f52'/>
  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d='M46 46 Q50 49 54 46' fill='none' stroke='#1f8f52' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M40 22 L36 12 L45 19 Z' fill='#ffe27a' stroke='#d9852a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M60 22 L64 12 L55 19 Z' fill='#ffe27a' stroke='#d9852a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='33' r='5' fill='#26304a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='33' r='5' fill='#26304a'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='30' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='30' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='35' r='1' fill='#aef2ff'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='35' r='1' fill='#aef2ff'/>
  <!-- tiny sparkle stars around head -->
  <path d='M72 22 l1.5 3 3 1.5 -3 1.5 -1.5 3 -1.5 -3 -3 -1.5 3 -1.5 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M28 16 l1 2 2 1 -2 1 -1 2 -1 -2 -2 -1 2 -1 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
